query.text: 请看着我做这道菜，如果有不规范或有安全隐患的操作请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch me cook this dish and warn me immediately if there are any improper or unsafe practices.

annotation.text_zh: 微波炉加热蛋液两分钟太久，容易变硬炸开。
annotation.text_en: Microwaving the eggs for two minutes is too long; they might get tough or explode.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
